svg.title: DeskOS: from organizational intent to workstation images
svg.desc: DeskOS flow. Organizational intent: a Workstation and Profiles in YAML, layered foundation, organization, role, workstation; the higher layer wins. deskosctl validates, composes, plans a typed IR and renders a build context deterministically: same inputs give a byte-identical plan. The Containerfile builds a bootc OCI image, one per platform: CentOS Stream 10, published at quay.io/deskos/deskos-core, and RHEL 10, built privately with a subscription and not published. bootc-image-builder makes QCOW2 disks and installer ISOs from the image.
